title: ROOT Harness Pipeline Configuration
description: Defines pipeline stages, transitions, gatekeeper bindings, and precondition expressions for a domain. Pipeline stages represent the workflow states that documents pass through; they are distinct from SAGE lifecycle states. See ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Section 7.3 and Instantiation Checklist items #7, #10.

stages.description: Named pipeline stages for this domain. Ordered by typical workflow progression, though transitions define the actual valid paths.

value.description: Machine identifier for the pipeline stage.

description.description: What work happens in this stage.

applicable_doc_types.description: Which doc_types participate in this stage. If omitted, the stage applies to all doc_types.

transitions.description: Valid transitions between pipeline stages. Each transition may have gatekeeper bindings and preconditions.

from_stage.description: Source pipeline stage. Use '(entry)' for the initial transition when a document enters the pipeline.

gatekeeper.description: The steward agent responsible for governing this transition. The steward evaluates preconditions, assembles evidence, and routes the decision (approve, reject with remediation, or escalate to human).

agent_id.description: Reference to the registered agent that governs this transition.

escalation_policy.description: What happens when preconditions fail and the gatekeeper cannot resolve them autonomously.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be satisfied before the transition is permitted. Evaluated by the governing steward using SAGE Core API calls (check_preconditions, traverse, get_editors).

check.description: The type of precondition check. lifecycle_status: document must be in a specified lifecycle state. required_edges_exist: specified edge types must exist on the document. editor_registered: specified editors must be registered. dependent_documents_complete: documents linked by depends_on edges must be in a completed state. metadata_fields_populated: specified metadata fields must have values. custom: a domain-specific expression.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this precondition verifies.

parameters.description: Check-specific parameters. For lifecycle_status: {required_status: 'active'}. For required_edges_exist: {edge_types: ['covers', 'bundles_with']}. For metadata_fields_populated: {fields: ['doc_type', 'project']}. For custom: {expression: '...'}.

requires_human_approval.description: Whether this transition requires explicit human-in-the-loop approval via a LangGraph interrupt node, regardless of precondition status. See Instantiation Checklist item #12.
